700937.ov: A dacoit named Lakhan Pal kidnaps a girl called Chandrika. He tries to rape her along with his gang members. Chandrika bites Lakhan's hand and applies his blood on her forehead making him her husband so that he protects her. They have a son Sunil.

701449.ov: A teacher, Bappa More, decides to capitalise on the deficiencies and ambiguities in the national education system to enrich himself. To achieve his goal, he weds a gullible teacher in a village.

719113.ov: A story about a mother's struggle and dilemma to accept her son as he is. An illiterate poor widow accidently finds out that her son is gay.

826377.ov: While attending a funeral, Maee, a typical housewife realizes that in situations like these people often look for a photo of the deceased that can be put up in his/her remembrance. She realizes that being the photophobic that she is, she doesn't have a good picture to be put up after her.

963081.ov: Aleesha, a photographer and wife of a wealthy mining industrialist, grows increasingly disillusioned with her family's business interest after witnessing the environmental impact that mining has on the Goan natural enviornment.

1182089.ov: Bali, who is mistreated by the villagers, saves Mukta from certain death. Soon, his rivalry with a man leads to Mukta's husband's death, after which Bali decides to care for her and her child.

1184777.ov: Hee Vat Pandharichi is a 1981 re-release of Marathi Devotional film Johar Maibaap Starring P. L. Deshpande, Sulochana, Vivek in lead roles.

1484297.ov: Suraj falls in love with a minister's daughter and tries to win her heart. However, his plan leads him on an unexpected adventure of love and friendship.

1645449.ov: Mumbai-the city of dreams. Three strangers, one wild ride. Scams, an ATM robbery, and a gangster with taste. Chaos turns into comedy as Amar, Akbar and Anthony take on the city. Unfiltered fun, unstoppable laughter-its all here.

1699337.ov: In a society where body image is scrutinized from an early age, Changing Room follows 12-year-old Pratik, an introverted overweight boy. In the seemingly mundane setting of a clothing store, casual remarks and unspoken judgments unravel the silent struggles of a child grappling with self-worth.
